ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 9:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central white region (high intensity) spanning approximately 85% of surface area; low-intensity black pigmentation restricted to a continuous border along the trailing edge and concentrated at both distal tips; one small focal dark spot visible in the mid-upper section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 72 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 12% of the vertical bounding box of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire boundary; average peak-to-valley amplitude is higher on the distal thirds of each lobe compared to the region adjacent to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral sigmoidal curve; convex curvature initiating at the median notch transitioning to a shallow concavity before reaching the tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of dark, roughly circular pixel formations on the extreme distal tip of the left lobe; additional smaller clusters visible on the trailing edge of the right lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, faint diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed on the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular pigmentation and minor structural 'notching' at the extreme distal tips, consistent with historical tissue loss or parasitic scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high global albedo across the ventral surface with a notable absence of interior mottling or heavy scarring common in the species.
